summary: Yeary Valley Farms: operator site (RoverPass-hosted) + claimed RoverPass listing (updated today) + Esri + Google. RV $40/$250/$650 (under the $50 gate), 50A/water/sewer back-ins, instant book, recent short-stay reviews; ~11-14 pads. Long-stay tests pass on the evidence read (no discouraging wording, no minimum); OHV side flagged.
flags: LONG-STAY TESTS: pass on what was read. Daily, weekly and monthly are sold on one 'RV Sites' plan with instant book; no wording discourages nightly guests, no minimum stay, not 55+, not weekly-only. Recent RoverPass reviews (11/2/2026 x2, 10/5/2026) are short trips. The nightly share could NOT be measured: the RoverPass calendar needs date picking and was not walked, and no site count is published (imagery: ~11 angled pads in the west row plus ~3 east of the cabins; some rigs present, permanence unknown). Google 4.9 (36); RoverPass 4.9 (105).
PRICE GATE: cheapest RV electric night $40 (operator rates page, and the claimed RoverPass listing Last Updated 11/25/2026) - passes the US$50 gate.

OHV FLAG (not a drop): the home page leads with a required 'OHV Property Pass, per buggy, per visit', is '2 miles to Tackett Creek' with a 'new trail', and reviews mention riding Tackett Creek. It also sells cabins, a fishing pond and Norris Lake access, so it reads as a general farm campground with an OHV side rather than a trail-system staging camp - reviewer's call.
Facilities: a 2026-11-02 review mentions a 'Bath house' (stocked, spotless) - showers not confirmed by the operator, so not written.

Phone 606-304-8729 confirmed (operator page, Google). Website https://yearyvalleyfarms.com/ confirmed (operator domain, RoverPass-hosted). Waterfront 'not waterfront' kept (the pond is far under 2 ha). Pin fine (Google 36.45162,-83.92101, ~48 m). Good Sam false (derived) left alone.
